name: lattice-parallel-dispatch
title: Productize Lattice Parallel Dispatch planning, status, merge queue, and dev-memory context
description: Turn Lattice Parallel Wave from planning-only projection into a safer operator surface: dispatch manifests, status aggregation, serial merge queue guidance, evidence/report aggregation, and bounded project dev-memory context references. Keep all outputs non-authoritative and avoid automatic agent spawning until host runners expose a signed dispatch API.
